name: Project Context renders seeded documents read-only, with no edit affordance
description: From the seeded acme/payments-api repo, open Project Context via the sidebar. The seeded clone is never pre-scanned (server/src/db/seed.ts never sets scanned_at), so the page starts on the 'No spec files yet' empty state until the first scan — trigger it via the 'Re-index' button and assert the settled 'files indexed' status line renders afterward (not the transient 'Indexing…' spinner, which would be timing-flaky). Then select the seeded specs/public-api.md document and confirm its filename and rendered H1 body ('Public API — PRD') are visible. Dump the page text with `get text body` and assert it EXCLUDES 'Upload', 'Delete', and 'Edit' — no control anywhere in this tree offers to mutate the document (AC-2; 'Edit', not the generic lowercase substring 'edit', because the read-only notice's own copy contains '...can't be edited here'). Finally switch to the second seeded repo (acme/docs-portal, clone_path null) via the sidebar repo switcher — which always routes to /pulls, so Project Context must be reopened from the sidebar — and assert the not-cloned empty-state copy from client/messages/en/context.json renders. Read-only seeded data throughout — no model call. Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api is the first repo (guaranteed by e2e-web.yml / scripts/e2e.sh). NOTE: the fifth EC-2 leg (empty state naming scanned roots on a root-only clone with zero matching spec files) is NOT covered — the seed fixture only provides a fully-populated clone (acme/payments-api) and a null-clone_path repo (acme/docs-portal); there is no seeded repo that is cloned but yields zero specs/docs/insights matches, and inventing one is out of scope for this task (server/src/db/seed.ts is owned by T13).

root redirects to the first repo's PR list
open Project Context via the sidebar
navigate to the context route
context page settles
unscanned clone shows the empty state (context.json empty.title)
trigger the first scan
scan request settles
settled status line ('N files indexed') renders after the scan, not the spinner
select the seeded public-api.md document
document's rendered H1 body is visible
page text excludes an Upload control
page text excludes a Delete control
page text excludes an Edit control
open the repo switcher
switch to the second seeded repo
repo switch lands on the new repo's PR list (RepoSwitcher always routes to /pulls)
open Project Context again for the second repo
navigate to the second repo's context route
not-cloned state settles
not-cloned title renders (context.json notCloned.title)
